name: @chrischall/musescore-mcp

tools.name: musescore_search
tools.description: Search musescore.com for sheet music. Returns score cards with id, title, uploader/arranger, original composer(s), instrumentation, page/part counts, duration, upload date, view/save counts, difficulty, PRO/Official badges, and MuseScore's listedFree/listedDownloadable catalogue flags (these do NOT guarantee a free PDF for your account). Defaults to MuseScore's 'Free to view, play & download' facet (free_only=true); set free_only=false to search the whole catalog (most of which is paywalled for download). The free facet narrows results but does NOT guarantee a free account can download a given score — that is enforced at download time. Read-only.

free_only.description: Restrict to the "Free to view, play & download" facet. Defaults to true.

instrument.description: Instrument facet: a supported instrument name (e.g. piano, guitar, violin, flute, trombone, baritone, tuba, organ, bassoon, saxophone alto, euphonium, cornet, accordion, soprano, alto, voice), or a MuseScore numeric instrument id (e.g. 2=piano, 72=guitar, 4=trombone). Unrecognized names error — pass the numeric id instead.

tools.name: musescore_get_score
tools.description: Fetch a single MuseScore score page and return its metadata: title, uploader/arranger, original composer(s), license, page/part counts, duration, measures, key, privacy, and upload/update dates. Identify the score by either a url (a musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path) or a user_id + score_id pair. Read-only; does not download the score (free-download eligibility is decided per-account at download time).

url.description: A musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path. Provide this OR user_id + score_id.

tools.name: musescore_score_to_pdf
tools.description: Resolve or create a PDF for a MuseScore score. If the score exposes an official PDF download and is free (is_free) or accessible (hasAccess), downloads the official PDF bytes to output_path (written: true, bytes, outputPath). Otherwise (incl. paid scores, or when the official download fails) fetches the page-1 render SVG — the score’s public thumbnail — and stitches it into output_path. The score is identified by a url (a musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path) or a user_id + score_id pair. Requires a signed-in MuseScore session. Every result leads with status: "complete" (all pages), "partial" (page 1 only — NOT the full score), "gated" (the official PDF needs a purchase/Premium; requiresPurchase:true) or "open_in_browser" (open downloadUrl in your signed-in browser). When the MCP runs behind a remote bridge (hosted), the PDF is returned inline as an embedded resource and output_path is ignored.

url.description: A musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path. Provide this OR user_id + score_id.

output_path.description: Local .pdf path to write (defaults to "<title>.pdf"). Parent directories are created. Ignored behind a remote bridge, where the file is returned inline. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads); a relative path is resolved against it. An existing file is never overwritten — a numbered sibling (e.g. score-2.pdf) is written instead and returned as outputPath.

dpi.description: Deprecated/ignored — SVG-stitch conversion is now vector (no rasterisation).

pages.description: 1-based page numbers for SVG-stitch mode. Only page 1 is available locally (pages 2+ are gated); requesting any other page errors. Ignored when an official PDF is downloaded. Defaults to page 1.

mode.description: auto (default): the 3-tier fallback chain — official PDF (if entitled) → SVG-stitch PDF → PNG render → structured "gated". The result reports which tier won via `via` (official_pdf | svg_pdf | png_render | gated) and, for renders, pagesRendered/pagesTotal/truncated. official: official PDF only (gated → structured gated). svg: page-1 SVG stitched to a PDF. png: page-1 PNG render written as a .png (for scores rendered as PNG but not SVG). render tiers cover page 1; truncated:true means pages 2+ are gated (use official/auto for the full document).

annotations.title: Resolve or create a MuseScore score PDF

tools.name: musescore_fetch_svgs
tools.description: Download a score’s per-page render SVGs (from musescore.com/static) into output_dir as page_<n>.svg. Pairs with musescore_svg_to_pdf. On a hosted server nothing is written and output_dir is ignored: the result lists files[] with a download url and a blobKey per page — pass the blobKeys to musescore_svg_to_pdf as svg_blob_keys. Page 1 is always rendered (it is the score’s public thumbnail, so paid scores work too); multi-page scores succeed and the result carries pagesRendered/pagesTotal/truncated (truncated:true means pages 2+ are gated behind a protected API).

url.description: A musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path. Provide this OR user_id + score_id.

output_dir.description: Local directory to write page_<n>.svg into. Created if missing. Required on a local install; ignored on a hosted server. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads); a relative path is resolved against it. An existing file is never overwritten — a numbered sibling (e.g. score-2.pdf) is written instead and returned as outputPath.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to fetch. Only page 1 is available locally (pages 2+ are gated behind a protected API); requesting any other page errors. Defaults to page 1.

annotations.title: Fetch a score’s page SVGs to a directory

tools.name: musescore_download
tools.description: Get the official MuseScore file for a free or already-entitled score (pdf, mid, mscz, or mxl). Identify the score by a url (a musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path) or a user_id + score_id pair. Without output_path it returns the official download URL for you to open in your signed-in browser tab; with output_path it downloads the actual file bytes (incl. multi-page official PDF) to that local path. For PDF downloads, setting fallback_svg=true will render page 1 from its SVG when the official download is likely blocked (not free, no hasAccess) or fails (403, S3 error). If a score is view-free but its download is Premium/purchase-gated, returns a structured {status:"gated", requiresPurchase:true, downloadUrl, scoreUrl, svgStitchAvailable} result (no file written) rather than erroring. Behind a remote bridge (hosted MCP) official files cannot be fetched: output_path is ignored and the result is {status:"open_in_browser", downloadUrl} — or, with fallback_svg, the page-1 render returned inline.

url.description: A musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path. Provide this OR user_id + score_id.

output_path.description: If set, download the file bytes for the chosen format to this local path (parent dirs created). Omit to just resolve the official URL. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads); a relative path is resolved against it. An existing file is never overwritten — a numbered sibling (e.g. score-2.pdf) is written instead and returned as outputPath.

fallback_svg.description: If true and the official PDF download is likely blocked (not free, no hasAccess) or fails (403, S3 error), fall back to rendering page 1 as a PDF from its SVG thumbnail. Defaults to false. Only applies when format is "pdf" and output_path is set.

annotations.title: Resolve or download an official MuseScore file

tools.name: musescore_healthcheck
tools.description: Round-trips a small public musescore.com URL (/robots.txt) through ContextMint Bridge (your signed-in browser tab) and returns diagnostics: the bridge's role (host/peer/null), port, version, the extension link (linked / pair pending / not attached / never answered), the elapsed round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from 'this browser can't serve a capability' from 'real musescore.com-side problem'. Read-only, no auth required. Also reports which browser the bridge is paired with, whether official downloads can work there, and whether files are written locally or returned inline (remote bridge). Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke.

annotations.title: Verify the ContextMint Bridge connection end-to-end

tools.name: musescore_svg_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert SVG or SVGZ pages into a PDF, one input file per page. Pass exactly one of: svg_paths (local files on this machine — local installs only), svg_blob_keys (the files[].blobKey values musescore_fetch_svgs returned on a hosted server), or svg_files (inline base64). Locally the PDF is written to output_path; on a hosted server it is returned as a download link (fileUrl) and output_path is ignored. Does not fetch files from MuseScore or any remote URL.

svg_paths.description: Local .svg or .svgz file paths, in page order. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads), e.g. the paths musescore_fetch_svgs returned. Not available on a hosted server.

svg_blob_keys.description: Hosted server: the files[].blobKey values from musescore_fetch_svgs, in page order, passed exactly as returned.

svg_files.description: SVG pages as inline base64, in page order: {filename (ending .svg or .svgz), contentBase64}.

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot. Its extension sets the MIME type when mimeType is omitted.

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, standard base64 (line breaks and a "data:<type>;base64," prefix are tolerated).

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg". Default: inferred from the filename extension.

output_path.description: Local .pdf path to write (required on a local install). Parent directories are created. On a hosted server only its file name is used, for the download. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads); a relative path is resolved against it. An existing file is never overwritten — a numbered sibling (e.g. score-2.pdf) is written instead and returned as outputPath.

dpi.description: Deprecated/ignored — conversion is now vector (no rasterisation).

tools.name: musescore_register_session
tools.description: Register (or refresh) an authenticated MuseScore session keyed by signed-in account identity. Re-registering the same `account_identity` updates the existing session rather than creating a duplicate. Returns the `session_id` to use when routing per-tool calls. The first registered session becomes the default `active_session_id`. Pass `mark_active: true` to make the newly-registered session active in the same call.

account_identity.description: Caller-supplied identifier for the signed-in account (typically the saved-account email).

auth_expires_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp at which the session expires.

mark_active.description: When true, immediately make the newly-registered session the active one.

tools.name: musescore_set_active_session
tools.description: Switch which registered session subsequent tool calls route through by default. Pass a `session_id` previously returned by `musescore_register_session`. Tools that accept an explicit `session_id` parameter override this default per-call.

tools.name: musescore_get_session_context
tools.description: Return the full set of registered sessions plus the current `active_session_id`. When no sessions are registered, `sessions` is empty and `active_session_id` is null.
